jobs_results.title: Junior Project Manager
jobs_results.description:
Do you have a passion for luxury superyachts? Join us at ptw Shipyard, where we are searching for talented individuals to fill the role of Junior Project Manager. As a Junior Project Manager, you will play a pivotal role in planning and overseeing boat projects, ensuring impeccable quality, adherence to schedules, and budget management.

EXPERIENCE

Minimum of 2 years of relevant experience.

RESPONSIBILITIES
• Collaborate in the development of project documents and templates.
• Ensure strict compliance with quality and project standards.
• Monitor project phases to ensure they are executed on time, within budget, and meet the client's approved quality standards.
• Provide support to the Senior Project Manager in coordinating and supervising project tasks.
• Act as a liaison with the client's representative during the ship's stay at the shipyard.
• Organize and supervise work across different departments.
• Manage internal project documentation and schedules.
• Execute reporting... activities for your project portfolio and team as directed.
• Thrive in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment, consistently delivering excellent results.
• Adhere to company rules, regulations, and safety procedures.
• Maintain a clean and safe work area, upholding professional work standards.
• Perform other reasonable duties within the scope of this role, as required by operations management.

SKILLS & COMPETENCIES
• Pragmatic with the ability to establish clear priorities while respecting project schedules.
• Results-oriented mindset.
• Ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
• Strong internal customer orientation.

SOFTWARE SKILLS
• Proficiency in ERP business management software.
• Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Project, Outlook, and PowerPoint).
• Familiarity with design and project management software, such as SolidWorks, SolidEdge, AutoCAD, Asana, SmartSheet, Monday, or similar tools.

LANGUAGES

Fluent in Spanish, with a high level of proficiency in spoken and written English. Knowledge of other languages is a plus.

TRAINING
• Background in Naval Engineering, Technical Naval Engineering, or an equivalent University Degree.
• Additional training in Project Management will be considered an asset.

CONTRACT TYPE & SALARY
• Permanent contract.
• Full-time position.
• Competitive salary package, including 30 days of paid vacation.

AVAILABILITY

Immediate incorporation.

Join our dynamic team at ptw Shipyard and immerse yourself in the world of luxury superyachts. Apply today to be a part of our mission to deliver excellence in every boat project we undertake.

jobs_results.title: Compliance Project Manager - Eastern Europe
jobs_results.description:
This a Full Remote job, the offer is available from: Europe

Binance is the leading global blockchain ecosystem and cryptocurrency infrastructure provider whose suite of financial products includes the world’s largest digital-asset exchange.
Our mission is to accelerate cryptocurrency adoption and increase the freedom of money.

If you’re looking for a fast-paced, mission-driven organization where opportunities to learn and excel are endless, then Binance is the place for you.

Responsibilities
• Prepare and maintain project documents (e.g. kick-off, road map, status updates, RAID log, steering committees, gap analysis etc.) to ensure proper control framework
• Oversee engagement and deployment of vendor solutions globally and work with global compliance managers to set up new processes
• Coordinate with global and regional team to lead change and best-practices, as well as perform read-across to identify gaps and driving projects to close the gaps
• Ensure proper coordination and... engagement with compliance and other cross functional stakeholders to work and drive towards project outcome
• Participate in requirements gathering and drafting of BRD where required, and design efficient tool workflows
• Perform business analysis, process mapping, and providing solutions and recommendations for respective projects
• Support in preparing project update slides for senior management reporting ensuring all artifacts such as minutes and action are detailed and circulated in a timely manner
• Participate in internal and external programs related to AML/CFT and other subjects that may form part of the day to day work requirements
• Any general administration and ancillary activities as may be required and related to the above functions in accordance with the business requirements of the Company

Requirements
• Bachelor's degree in a Business, Finance, Legal, or related field, or equivalent practical experience
• 3-5 years of experience in project management at a financial institution or fintech company
• Knowledgeable of compliance area and vendor solutions
• PMP certification required, PRINCE2 or other certifications will be an advantage
• Experience working with directly with an independent compliance monitor or financial regulators preferred
• Ability to proactively and assertively communicate to project stakeholders where required
• Ability to navigate through ambiguity in a fast-paced, dynamic environment
• Excellent attention to detail, with the ability to be action-oriented and seek to meet high standards
• Excellent written and verbal communication, time management, analytical, and investigative skills

Working at Binance
• Be a part of the world’s leading blockchain ecosystem that continues to grow and offers excellent career development opportunities
• Work alongside diverse, world-class talent in an environment where learning and growth opportunities are endless
• Tackle fast-paced, challenging and unique projects
• Work in a truly global organization, with international teams and a flat organizational structure
• Competitive salary and benefits
• Balance life and work with flexible working hours and casual work attire

Learn more about how Binancians embody the organization’s core values, creating a unified culture that enables collaboration, excellence, and growth.

Apply today to be a part of the Web3 revolution!

Binance is committed to being an equal opportunity employer. We believe that having a diverse workforce is fundamental to our success.

By submitting a job application, you confirm that you have read and agree to our Candidate Privacy Notice.

This offer from "Binance" has been enriched by Jobgether.com and got a 84.25% flex score

jobs_results.title: Project Manager - Oncology - Europe - Home-based
jobs_results.description:
This a Full Remote job, the offer is available from: Europe

Who We Are

Worldwide Clinical Trials (Worldwide), a leading global contract research organization (CRO), works in partnership with biotechnology and pharmaceutical companies to create customized solutions that advance new medications – from discovery to reality. Anchored in our company’s scientific heritage, our dedicated therapeutic focus on cardiovascular, metabolic, neuroscience, oncology, and rare diseases, is applied to develop flexible plans and solve problems quickly for our customers.

Our talented team of 3,000+ professionals spans 60+ countries. We are united in cause with our customers to improve the lives of patients through new and innovative therapies. **

Why Worldwide**

We believe everyone plays an important role in making a world of difference for patients and their caregivers. From our hands-on, accessible leaders, to our cohesive and supportive teams, we are committed to enabling professionals from all... backgrounds and experiences to succeed. We prioritize cultivating a diverse and inclusive environment that continues to promote collaboration and creativity. We are proud to be a workplace where people thrive by being themselves and are inspired to do their best work every day. Join us! **

What Project Management Does At Worldwide**

Worldwide Clinical Trials Project management is the perfect blend of operational rigor and therapeutic expertise, with a client-focused approach. Our Global Project Leads (GPLs) and Clinical Project Managers (CPMs) expertly guide our project teams to deliver with high quality, focusing on “doing it right the first time”.

The Project Management team is engaged in all aspects of the trial collaborating with scientific and therapeutic leadership, coordinating across project teams, and providing flexible, innovative and proactive solutions. At Worldwide, you will be dedicated to a specific therapeutic area which will not only give you an opportunity to develop in depth global operational expertise, but also benefit from exceptional scientific and medical background that our experts bring. **

What You Will Do**
• Project Manager (PM) is responsible for the overall coordination and management of clinical trials from start up through closeout activities.
• Directs the technical, financial and operational aspects of the projects -- thus securing the successful completion of clinical trials.
• Works with functional area leads to identify and evaluate fundamental project requirements, interpret data on complex issues, is responsible for contingency planning and implementation of rescue strategy where needed and ensure solutions are implemented.
• Works to ensure that all project deliverables meet the customer’s time/quality/cost expectations
• The PM, with support from the Project Management Directors, working in collaboration with other functional area leads, is accountable for ensuring that all project deliverables meet the customer/contract expectations

What You Will Bring To The Role
• Experience in managing projects in a multi-office environment
• Ability to handle multiple competing priorities and utilize resources effectively
• Inspire effective teamwork and motivate staff within a matrix system, lead by example and encourage team members to seek solutions
• Excellent communication, planning and organizational skills
• Self-motivated and excellent problem-solving skills
• Ability to negotiate and liaise with clients in a professional manner

Your Experience
• 5+ years' Clinical Project Management experience required within a CRO setting is preferred
• University/College degree, within Life Science is preferred
• Thorough knowledge of project management processes with a solid understanding of how to craft and manage a project budget
• Can demonstrate experience of successfully managing and/or leading multidisciplinary project teams
• Ability to travel when needed

We love knowing that someone is going to have a better life because of the work we do.

To view our other roles, check out our careers page at www.worldwide.com/careers! For more information on Worldwide, visit www.Worldwide.com or connect with us on LinkedIn.

We’re a global, mid-size CRO that pushes boundaries, innovates and invents — because the path to a cure for the world’s most persist diseases is not paved by those who play it safe, but by those who take pioneering, creative approaches, and implement them with quality and excellence. We are experts, bright thinkers, dreamers and doers and, together, we are changing the way the world experiences CROs, in the best possible way.

This offer from "Worldwide Clinical Trials" has been enriched by Jobgether.com and got a 77% flex score

jobs_results.title: Project Manager
jobs_results.description:
Do you get a kick out of projects that run smoothly from start to finish with a stunning end result? Are you ready to be given a lot of responsibility within the projects you run and do you feel like working for fat hospitality companies? Then be sure to read on!

Hi, we are The Fully Bookers
We are the online marketing agency dedicated to the hospitality industry. Every day, we help (inter)national hotels and restaurants such as Anne & Max, Proeflokaal Bregje, Pizza Beppe, Carlton and Parco Ibiza in making their dreams come true in terms of visibility, reach and profit.

With our years of experience for this sector, we have interesting data and the right experience to help these entrepreneurs maximise their occupancy rates.

We are a fast-growing organisation where the Project Management team is responsible for running all the projects we run with our clients.

Project Manager
As Project Manager at The Fully Bookers, you help our clients achieve maximum results by organising project... activities properly. After team Account has coordinated the strategy, you make sure it is implemented: you plan, execute, monitor and adjust where necessary. For this, you work closely with the client and our internal experts.

You will have a lot of freedom to shape your work, but we expect you to ensure that projects are delivered on time, within budget and of excellent quality. You have perseverance and know what Agile working entails. In addition, you make the project progress and results transparent to our customers.

Our new Project Manager has project management skills, is incisive and knows how to get things done. You are innovative and come up with creative solutions when needed. You have in-depth knowledge of the world of online marketing, closely follow the latest developments and have a demonstrable affinity with the hospitality industry.

You have at least three years' experience within project management on an agency side. You are fluent in Dutch, have strong communication skills and are proficient in English. Your enthusiastic energy gets people involved in your projects to achieve the best possible results. We are looking for someone who can work full-time.

What do we have to offer you?
In everything we do within The Fully Bookers, we keep our core values in mind:

BETTER is what we do best

BOLD is our middle name

With us, you get the chance to work with the top 10 per cent within the hospitality industry. We provide the necessary equipment and a nice workplace at our office in The Hague. It is also possible to regularly work from home.

Because we believe in mutual trust, you will receive a permanent contract immediately, with pension accrual. The salary indication for this position is between €3,000 and €4,000 per month, depending on your experience.

We also believe that you need to develop to on top of your game remain, hence we provide annual training funds. To relax, you have the opportunity to participate in company fitness, chair massage, monthly drinks and a biannual company outing. To explore the world or remodel your home, you have 24 fixed, four optional holidays available. Should you have the dream of working from abroad, this is possible for five weeks a year.

Do our core values appeal to you? And do you recognise yourself in the description above? Top! Then apply immediately via the following link and we will get back to you as soon as possible.

Acquisition on the basis of this vacancy is not appreciated: we like to use our own network to find the right person.
Want to come and bolster our team?

We're the number 1 in online marketing for restaurants and hotels. With offices in The Hague and Amsterdam, although working from home is an option, too.
#J-18808-Ljbffr

jobs_results.title: Project Manager
jobs_results.description:
How did that old saying go again? "Word hard, Play Hard!". Exactly, neatly said: Our Barcelona office is in need of a talented Project Manager to work on a specific international client project related to Fintech. Are you meticulous and enjoy the freedom to manage your own time? That's a mentality we strongly identify with. Does it resonate with you? Great, because we are expanding our team and seeking you as a new contractor colleague for this role.
Requirements

As a Project Manager, you will be part of one of our 3 self-organizing customer teams. Working together with a Functional Implementation Consultant and an Implementation Engineer, you will optimize the usage of our proocesses for one specific Fintech related client. This Project includes implementing an innovating customer onboarding and dashboard solution adding new functionalities to the existing platform and performing upgrades. In addition to technical implementation, the focus is also on (acceptance of) organizational... change. Nothing is set in stone! We have a standard approach, but you and your team determine what is needed to deliver the best solution for the client.
Responsibilities
• You are responsible for the success of Xtendis implementation projects.
• You lead the implementation process from initiation, implementation, realization (go live), to delivery.
• You establish a partnership with your clients and ensure a smooth onboarding process.
• Working iteratively with your client team, you strive for an optimal working solution.
• You actively contribute to building a community of satisfied customers and play a role in achieving our ambitions through your personality and dedication.
• You provide the necessary structure to make each project a success, managing results, scope, and timing.
• You collaborate with the Cloud team and Developers who create the tools, identifying commercial opportunities that you communicate to the account manager.
• After successful project delivery, you ensure a seamless handover to the Support Engineers.
Details
• Focus on building secure and high-quality products.
• Based in Barcelona, Spain, with opportunities to connect with colleagues worldwide.
• Hybrid working model, combining office and remote work.
• Excellent secondary employment benefits.
• Opportunities for personal and professional growth within a mature and flexible organization.

Medialaab bridges the realms of branding, technology, and data to empower socially and culturally relevant brands worldwide. By integrating these disciplines, Medialaab enables brands to thrive and create a profound impact on their target audience in the digital age.
#J-18808-Ljbffr

jobs_results.title: Senior Clinical Project Manager, Remote, EU
jobs_results.description:
This a Full Remote job, the offer is available from: European Union, United Kingdom

Join us in redefining what it means to work for a CRO. Working at Rho, you’ll be joining a team who take healthcare and clinical research personally, with shared experiences that drive a passion to heal, cure and solve some of humanity’s biggest challenges.

At Rho, we’re committed to you just as you’re committed to us. You’ll have the opportunity to experience a thriving company with real stability - financial, workforce, and corporate, which has created a safe environment to innovate and develop over a long and rewarding career. With a collaborative team of smart, talented, and positive people, you’ll be celebrated and respected for your expertise and given the freedom to think creatively, challenge the norm, and problem-solve.

As a Senior Clinical Project Manager here at Rho, you’ll have the opportunity to provide leadership to cross-functional clinical research projects and team members. You’ll... need to provide on-time, on-budget, and high-quality project results as well as motivating, training and mentoring team members and helping develop new superior customer experiences while maintaining Rho’s core values, including Teamwork, Quality, Great People, among others. We’re looking to you to bring your expertise, leading complex projects and developing junior staff. • Lead complex projects, conceptualizing the execution strategy for each component project
• Prepare project management plans and other governance documents
• Recommend and implement operational strategies as well as risk management plans
• Manage assigned project resources, including ensuring that project tasks are correctly assigned to staff and vendors
• Manage project scope of work, including recognizing and negotiating changes in scope
• Make tactical recommendations to customers to improve projects and provide strategic and tactical guidance to team members
• Mentor and provide training and orientation for team members
• Manage team dynamics and provide frequent feedback to team members
• Collaborate with customers to provide win/win solutions
• Contribute to business development initiatives, including proposals, responses to RFIs, and bid defense presentations

• BS in life sciences or related field along with Minimum 5 years’ experience managing progressively larger and more complex clinical research projects
• Experience in CNS is preferred

• Experience in conducting on-site monitoring visits and/or managing activities of a CRA team to achieve project deliverables
• Strong Communicator: Demonstrate written, verbal and presentation skills to help showcase the successes of your work and Rho’s.

We work smart together, we work hard together, and we laugh together. We take responsibility for our actions, forgive honest mistakes and respect one another.
• Critical Thinker: Rho values thinking. Draw on your native ingenuity, sharpened and enhanced by our intellect, training, and experience. We evaluate situations and opportunities objectively and incisively; we then craft novel, practical solutions.
• Agile and Adaptable: Rho values the ability to change quickly. We eagerly anticipate, respond to, and take advantage of changes in our environment. We embrace risk but manage it by planning, accepting, and learning from both failures and successes. The opportunity to adapt and evolve energizes us.

A Few More Things To Know About Us

Diversity and Inclusion: As a global, full-service CRO driven by our collective experiences, we view each of our backgrounds as a vital component in our formula for success and we strive towards building a more equitable, inclusive, and diverse environment for our employees every day. By valuing and tapping into each employee’s unique and different personal experiences, we are able to uplift employee dignity and belonging, foster more strategic creativity, and more quickly arrive at breakthrough solutions that help us heal the world.

• Ensuring allocated projects are delivered on time, within scope and budget
• Coordinating internal resources and third parties/vendors for the execution of projects
• Consciously driving and managing change management
• Ensuring resource availability and allocation
• Manage change requests
• Ensure timely training for the end-users
• Report and escalate as needed
• Manage the relationship with all stakeholders
• Perform risk management to minimize project risks
• Create and maintain comprehensive project documentation
• Organize and perform UAT and final testing
• Prepare lessons-learned meetings and report learnings back into the organization

• Bachelor´s or master´s degree in economics, business management, financial management or equivalent professional education with several years of professional experience

• Additional languages such as German, Spanish, French, etc. are a big plus.

jobs_results.title: Project Manager IT in Las Palmas
jobs_results.description:
The ocean plays a significant role in addressing the major challenges we face today, such as offshore wind energy, deep-sea mining, maritime safety, and carbon footprint reduction. The maritime sector is actively working on solutions to tackle these challenges. Affordable and efficient cross-supply chain collaboration to ensure timely delivery is a challenge that requires attention. Companies are already stepping up to drive these efforts. Floorganise is actively engaged in shaping this future. Join us on this journey, utilizing your programming skills in either Zwolle (Netherlands) or our new office in Las Palmas de Gran Canaria (Spain).

Floorganise. Triggering smart Shipbuilding

As a project manager, you proactively engage in the internal improvement processes of our shipbuilding clients. Whether it involves shortening lead times, reducing risks, working hours, or enhancing the predictability of production standards. Your technical background (in business administration and IT... enables you to swiftly grasp shipbuilding and the challenges faced by our clients. You promptly identify potential improvement measures, partly due to the insights our MES application provides.

Your familiarity with Lean practices, along with your natural curiosity for finding ways to make things better, enables you to effectively lead projects and initiatives focused on improvement. Collaborating with your colleagues (the software development team) in Zwolle, you establish and oversee (sub) projects through to completion. For you, a commitment is steadfast, the customer comes first, your approach is organized, you foster a cooperative spirit, and occasional international travel (about 2 times a year for a week) posesnoissue.

PS: Did you know that the average age at Floorganise is 33yearsold?

We are a young company with big ambitions. There are more and more shipyards worldwide that are looking for a solution to bridge the distance between the office and the shop floor. Our Floor2Plan application supports them in a series of steps that occur in the primary process of shipbuilding. In addition to carrying out projects, we are very busy with R&D. The project manager also plays an important role in this.Namely, identifying improvement measures (based on the knowledge developed by our customers and their more generic issues), elaborating into improvement proposals and ensuring their implementation (testing what our developers engineer for this purpose). At Floorganise you have an excellent opportunity to develop and grow. You will also receive support from us in the form of training,courses,etc.
• You are ambitious and want to develop yourself
• You are customer oriented
• Willing to travel internationally occasionally
• You have knowledge and or further interest in LEAN
• You like to work independently, but in a good team
• Bachelor degree work level, towards mechanical engineering, IT shipbuilding, industrial engineering or similar
• Experience in managing(improvement)projects
• Beautiful challenging assignments, interesting and large clients
• Experienced and expert colleagues in a trusted permanent team
• A pleasant workplace, working with the latest tools
• You can work part-time with us and you will receive a competitve salary and benefits
• You get all the space for your personal development. You can see this very broadly in termsofeducation.

Major global players with tens of thousands of employees, such as Boskalis and IHC Merwede, have been working every day with our tools and ideas every day for many years. More than 300 dredgers, trailing suction hopper dredgers, luxury mega yachts and other large-scale shipbuilding projects have already been realized with Floorganise. We keep satisfied customers and we get new customers because our developers are constantly working on improving and expanding. Our customers realize significant savings in time and money through Floorganise.Damen, Boskalis, Van Oord, Zwijnenburg, Feadship, IHC Merwede, Nichols Brothers Boat Builders, Niestern Sander, Van Lent, Philly Shipyard, Oceanco, Van der Loo, Detyens, Mercury andIconYachts.

Want to know more?

Give us a call directly or send us a mail with your resume. We are looking forward toyourresponse!

Give Ronald a call at Ver el número de teléfono en click.appcast.io or mail to ronald(at) floorganise.com . You can reach him during and afterofficehours.

#J-18808-Ljbffr
